name: What causes kitchen renovation quotes to vary so much between contractors?

mainEntity.name: What causes kitchen renovation quotes to vary so much between contractors?
mainEntity.text: What causes kitchen renovation quotes to vary so much between contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen renovation quotes can differ dramatically because each contractor may be pricing a different scope, not just a different margin. One bid might include demolition, haul-away, permits, project management, and finish carpentry, while another leaves several items out. Labor rates, cabinet allowances, countertop assumptions, appliance installation, and site protection can also vary. Some contractors price aggressively and add change orders later, while others build more risk into the upfront number. That is why the lowest quote is not always the best value. Homeowners should compare bids line by line and verify that each contractor is pricing the same materials, the same level of finish, and the same permit and inspection responsibilities. If one bid is much lower than the rest, it usually means something is excluded, under-allowed, or underestimated. The most useful comparison is transparency, not just total price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quotes vary because contractors may use different labor rates, material allowances, scopes of work, permit assumptions, and project management standards. One bid may include more detail, better finishes, or more risk coverage than another. The cheapest quote is often missing something important.
